description: Filling areas of the n-point Kuratowski boundary curve in the sup-norm space L^inf_n.
units: Mathlib unnormalized mu_H^2; sup-norm plane = Lebesgue; Riemannian surface = (4/pi) x area; round hemisphere = 8
planar_projection_cap: any 1-Lipschitz map into a normed plane X plus covering gives at most L^2 / (lambda(B) lambda(B°)) <= L^2/8 = pi^2/2 (Busemann isoperimetric inequality + planar Mahler)

effective_dimension.note: even n is redundant: d(t, a+pi) = pi - d(t, a), so gamma_n with n even is an affine image of gamma_{n/2} on the anchors mod pi; the effective number of independent anchors is m = n/2 (n even) or n (n odd). Values are the best (minimum) ceiling over mesh levels; ceilings still decrease under refinement, so limits are upper estimates. n=2 uses the quarter pair (0, pi/2) and n=4 equidistant reduces to it, so both are m=2.
effective_dimension.reduced_rerun: even n re-optimized in reduced form by scripts/linf_reduced_rerun.py

extrapolation.superseded: the original fits in 1/n^2 over n = 3, 6, 12 / 4, 8, 16 mixed redundant configurations and pre-rerun ceilings; replaced by effective_dimension
